record.question: Which method helps reduce scatter radiation?
record.explanation: Answer B: Using grids. An anti-scatter grid absorbs scatter before it reaches the image receptor; it reduces detected scatter rather than scatter production. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
